detail: Full summary: Semantic inversion was the worst failure class, now fixed: 'Chose NOT to reorder the ladder to prefer the bundled server over npx' stored 'npx' as the REJECTED option when npx is what was KEPT. A negated-choice veto suppresses unordered extraction inside chose/decided/opted-not-to clauses while leaving labelled forms intact.
